title: RFC 9457: Problem Details for HTTP APIs

chunks.title: RFC 9457: Problem Details for HTTP APIs
chunks.excerpt: This document defines a "problem detail" to carry machine-readable details of errors in HTTP response content to avoid the need to define new error response formats for HTTP APIs.

chunks.title: RFC 9457: Problem Details for HTTP APIs
chunks.excerpt: The "detail" string, if present, ought to focus on helping the client correct the problem, rather than giving debugging information.
